title: Slope Stability for ${\mathbf Z}_p$-Towers of Curves
summary: This work is devoted to a systematic study of slope stability for $\mathbf Z_p$-towers of the projective line over finite fields of characteristic $p$, ramified only at infinity. Our aim is to understand to what extent geometric stability of the genus sequence, or of the ramification break sequence, implies arithmetic stability of the Newton slopes of the zeta functions of the curves in the tower.
